**🎉 Celebrate National Day with Homestolife — Up to 80% Off + Up to additional $500 savings with any sofa purchase!**


This National Day, we’re celebrating more than just Singapore’s birthday — it’s about the joy of coming home to comfort and style. Your dream sofa. Your perfect home. All at unbeatable prices.


**🎁 Special National Day Perks — Just for You**


Enjoy up to 80% Off & Up to additional $500 savings with any sofa purchase!


---


Exclusive Gifts and Limited-time Deals:


**🛋️ Up to additional $500 savings with any Sofa purchase:**


- 🚛 **Free Sofa Disposal** (worth up to $180)
- 💤 **Free 2 Pillows** (worth $118, while stocks last)
- 🧼 **Free Leather or Fabric Care Kit** (worth $49.90)


- Leather Carekit with min. purchase of $2k
- Fabric Carekit with min. purchase of $1.2k


- 🚚 **Free Delivery** (worth up to $100)
- 🎁 **Additional $60 Off Bundle Deals**


Valid till 31 August.


---


**💥 GST? Don’t Worry — We’ve Got It Covered**


We’re **absorbing the 9% GST** on all *Made-to-Order Sofas* (excluding Style & Save). Just make full payment and you’re good to go.


Valid till 17 August.


---


**Jamie Chair for $60**


Add a pop of style to your living room with the charming **Jamie Chair** , now **only $60** with any sofa or case goods purchase. ( *Limit 4 per customer. While stocks last.* )


Valid till 17 August.


---


**Recliner TV Armchair – Only $999**


Your me-time just got better. The Recliner TV Armchair is now **$999** (save $600)!
Built for comfort and designed to impress:


- Posture Support
- Dual Motor
- Motorised Recliner
- Swivel


Valid till 31 August.


---


**🎁 Additional $60 Off Bundle Deals**


- Wally + Isla / Noah
- Angelo + Atwell


Perfect pairings to elevate your entire space — and your savings!


Don’t miss out — shop now and bring home the comfort you deserve.


📍 Visit Our HomesToLife Showrooms


Drop by to experience our made-to-order sofas in person, get expert styling tips, and enjoy exclusive in-store bundles.
